content: We now describe our general model for forecasting future conversational events. Our model integrates two components: (a) a generative dialog model that learns to represent conversational dynamics in an unsupervised fashion; and (b) a supervised component that fine-tunes this representation to forecast future events. Figure FIGREF13 provides an overview of the proposed architecture, henceforth CRAFT (Conversational Recurrent Architecture for ForecasTing).
